about: The table of contents of Sunan al-Darimi: its books (kitab) and their chapters (bab). The data isnady imports (3,367 hadith) carries no chapters; these are the headings of the edition named below, each placed at its hadith by matching the texts. The chapters are named in Turkish and English too (BK2c, written by hand from the Arabic).
